meta.title: Language FTS Preview
meta.description: Downloads, verifies, installs, and activates the published Language FTS core package, then opens the Settings > Full-Text Search sandbox.
meta.author: adamziel

steps.code:
<?php
$path = '/tmp/language-fts-core.zip';
$expected = '4a7baff284b74d7fc72d071f589730269748c66bb82f68b0ce426739f57bdc7f';
$actual = hash_file('sha256', $path);
if (! is_string($actual) || ! hash_equals($expected, $actual)) {
    throw new RuntimeException('Language FTS release checksum mismatch.');
}
